name: PT Formosa Ingredient Factory Tbk
summary: Established in 2016, PT Formosa Ingredient Factory Tbk operates from its headquarters in Tangerang, Indonesia. The company specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of a diverse range of beverage and dessert ingredients, including tapioca pearls, jelly toppings, popping boba, premium sauces, syrups, and premix powders, serving the Indonesian market.
